author: The Brain Scoop Community
description: A server-specific Music League game for The Brain Scoop Discord community. Members submit music links to bot-managed weekly playlists; the cog is under development.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores submitters' Discord user IDs, song titles, and links in the server's weekly playlists. The data is included in user data exports and removed through Red's user data deletion process.
install_msg: Thanks for installing MusicLeague. Admins can set the schedule time zone with `/musicleague timezone` and announcement channel with `/musicleague channel`. Use `/musicleague submit` and `/musicleague playlist` to play. This cog is under development.
name: MusicLeague
short: Bot-managed weekly Music League playlists (under development).
